messages.author: Dulal Mondal
messages.body:
Dear Experts,
I installed plumed in the root directory. Then I recompile the amber24
serial version. The plumed is properly patched with amber. But I can not
patch plumed in the super computer because I have no root access. So, How
can I patch plumed?
Thanking You
